## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the authorized task and approved decisions.
- [ ] No credentials, PHI, raw payloads, or restricted client documents are included.
- [ ] Synthetic fixtures and evidence are clearly labeled.
- [ ] Relevant failure cases and acceptance criteria are verified against this candidate.
- [ ] Dependency, deployment, database, and integration approvals are evidenced where applicable.
- [ ] Pending checks are reported accurately; foundation checks are not product verification.
